name: Doutei Gui ~Hitozuma no Akunaki In'yoku~
original_name: 童貞喰い ～人妻の飽くなき淫欲～
source:
The protagonist notices from a long time ago that he likes older woman. First is a teacher in his school, next is a friend's mother. And now, he can't take his eyes of a neighboring wife. Just thinking about losing his virginity to the women makes his heart go wild. And then suddenly, a chance appears.

[Translated from [url=http://incarose-soft.com/hitodumaf/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公很早就意识到自己喜欢成熟女性。先是学校里的女教师，接着是朋友的母亲。现在，他的目光又无法从邻家妻子身上移开。光是想象自己与这些女性失去处男之身，他的心就狂跳不已。然后，机会突然出现了。

[译自[url=http://incarose-soft.com/hitodumaf/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
